description: Implementation of synchronization classes including CriticalSection, BinarySemaphore, CountingSemaphore, and Event, with platform-specific code for Windows, POSIX, Linux, and Apple. Contains methods for thread synchronization, interlocked operations, and semaphore management.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: Encapsulates platform-specific thread critical section or mutex for synchronization.

classes.name: BinarySemaphore
classes.description: Implements a binary semaphore with platform-specific synchronization primitives.

classes.name: CountingSemaphore
classes.description: Implements a counting semaphore with platform-specific synchronization primitives.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Provides an event object for thread signaling within process space.

classes.name: SharedSemaphore
classes.description: Implements a shared semaphore, possibly across processes, with platform-specific code.

methods.name: InterlockedIncrement
methods.description: Performs an atomic increment operation on a variable, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: InterlockedDecrement
methods.description: Performs an atomic decrement operation on a variable, platform-specific implementation.
